title: Stepwise Trajectory Identity Preservation (Legacy Prior Cohort)
intuition: Historical pre-refactor comparison cohort of `trajectory` retained under its original prior ownership contract so legacy baselines stay strictly separated from `recipe_owned_v1` tasks. Verifies that multi-step generator updates maintain low identity distortion (identity_mse <= 0.02) consistently across the terminal evaluation window rather than drifting away over 400 updates.
failure_mode: Cumulative trajectory drift or poorly damped momentum steadily degrades identity_mse across updates.
protocol_notes: Retained legacy diagnostic cohort for `trajectory` before the recipe-owned prior refactor; cannot substitute for current ordinary qualification cells.
